form_title: 2010 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)

reports.notes: Handwritten; fax scan (header 'Dec. 2. 2010 10:20AM Ut Co Public Works'). This is a SEPARATE, LATER report from the same filer (Type of Report = '30 Days after the General Election', dated 12/2/10) whose summary figures are IDENTICAL to his 10/26/10 seven-days-preceding-General report (key 36982384) - no activity in between, per the filer. The two are not duplicates of each other: the checked report-type box and the signature/report dates differ. Zeros are the dash-zero-dash glyph '-0-', transcribed verbatim. Lines 3, 5, 7 are written as NEGATIVE amounts with a clear minus sign; transcribed as printed, no arithmetic applied. Cents are raised superscripts. The residence city on this cover is written in mixed case ('Springville', 'Utah') unlike the filer's earlier all-caps covers - transcribed as printed. office_index 'County Surveyor' agrees with the page. candidate_index was blank; the page names GARY RATCLIFFE.

itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-19 wave B2 utah, chunk r2_02b)

contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED, written as the dash-zero-dash glyph '-0-' (read 0 under the repo ZERO-GLYPH RULING), matched by Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Contributions Received', each a handwritten closed-loop zero
contributions.detail: Schedule A (p3) carries NO entries: 17 printed ruled lines, all blank in every column, except a two-line handwritten banner across the Name and Address columns of the first two lines — 'NO NEW CONTRIBUTIONS REC'D. SINCE / REPORT FILED ON 10/26/10'. A banner is an annotation, not an entry: no ruled line carries a date, a contributor or an amount. Zero rows sum to 0.00 = the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell (Column A line 1, '-0-') = the schedule's own printed page subtotal = its printed total (900 dpi crop of pct:78,82,20,9@p3 rendered both as plain closed loops). Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 2,700.00 and is NOT summed as an increment. The p2 balance ladder closes on its own terms and is NEGATIVE: line 3 -3,661.05 + line 4 (-0-) = line 5 -3,661.05; line 5 - line 6 (-0-) = line 7 -3,661.05. The sign is real and is kept.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE, written '-0-' (read 0), matched by Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Expenditures MADE', each a handwritten closed-loop zero
expenditures.detail: Schedule B (p4) likewise carries NO entries — 17 empty ruled lines under the two-line banner 'NO NEW EXPENDITURES MADE SINCE / REPORT FILED ON 10/26/10'. Zero rows sum to 0.00 = the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell = the schedule's own printed page subtotal = its printed total (900 dpi crop of pct:78,82,20,9@p4 rendered both as plain closed loops). Column B YTD expenditures print 6,361.05 and are never summed as an increment; that figure is this filer's June per-period total carried forward unchanged through both the October and the December reports.

itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable — neither schedule carries any entry, so monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind give the identical sum (0.00) on both sides and both close on the '-0-' Column A cells. Neither schedule prints an in-kind column and the cover prints no in-kind line.
itemized.escalation_note: Two escalations, both for legibility of the nil marks. make_snippet --dpi 900 on pct:78,82,20,9@p3 and pct:78,82,20,9@p4 rendered, on each page, the printed 'Subtotal for this page $' and 'Total ... $' labels each followed by a hand-drawn CLOSED LOOP — an unslashed handwritten zero, not a bare dash and not an empty cell — so under the ZERO-GLYPH RULING these are printed zeros and both sides are a real absence of entries. The p4 crop also captured the filer's own correction of the county's printed header, 'Total Expenditures ~~Received~~ MADE'.

geometry.provenance: printed-rule detection on the rendered page (scripts/campaign_finance/rowbands.py, raw-render frame): per-page frame = the Amount column band x one measured band per printed table row; a row's box is their intersection, in pct of the page as poppler renders it (rotation included)
